generate_test_data: generate test data with affine augmentation parameters including angle, translation, scale, and shear for a source image
warp_points: warp 2D coordinate points using an inverse affine transformation matrix
test_affine_angle: test affine angle transforms on an image with 45 and 90 degree rotations
test_affine_translation: test affine translation transforms on an image with translation values of 0, 1, and 2
test_affine_shear: test affine shear transforms on an image with shear values of 0, 1, and 2
